detection_rule: a family fires when any cell in the footprint dilated by one cell carries its flag; null_rate is the same footprint on the unmodified solution; smallest_reliable is the smallest theta extent from which every larger one reaches reliable_rate
limitation: Conservation flags are review cues, not errors: folds, tears, crushed regions and the scroll's start and end can break ray order, pitch and partner matching legitimately. A clean report says the stitched labels are self-consistent at the cell resolution; it does not establish CT support, recto coverage, or that the labels match the physical windings.
